headline: Construction Worker

education.credential: Senior High School, TVL Track – Industrial Arts strand
notes: Work immersion with a local building contractor
Masonry NC II training during Grade 12

summary: Senior high graduate from the Industrial Arts strand looking for work as a construction worker or mason helper. During work immersion I laid hollow blocks, mixed mortar, cleared and levelled building sites and covered finished floors to protect them. I am strong, reliable and eager to learn a trade.
skills: Masonry: hollow block laying, plastering, mortar mixing
Safe driving of site vehicles (student licence)

experience.title: Work Immersion Student
bullets: Laid hollow blocks and plastered walls on a two-storey house under a mason's supervision.
Cleared, levelled and compacted the site for a new warehouse.
Covered floors and window frames with protective sheets before painting work.
